title: Big Trucks, Little Bridge

pages.title: A bridge for everyone
pages.caption: Milo visits a muddy stream.
pages.speech: Milo wanted to visit his friend across the stream. The old stepping stones were under water. We need a little bridge, he said.
pages.art: A curious child in a yellow hard hat and red boots stands beside a stream; friendly orange digger and blue dump truck nearby.

pages.title: Look, then plan
pages.caption: Where can the bridge go?
pages.speech: First, the builders looked carefully. They chose firm ground on both banks. Milo drew a bridge with a wide path and strong sides.
pages.art: Same child draws a simple bridge plan on paper; two banks of stream and safe clear work area.

pages.title: Dig a steady base
pages.caption: The digger scoops the earth.
pages.speech: The orange digger scooped a little earth. Scoop, lift, and set it down. The workers made a steady place for each end of the bridge.
pages.art: Orange digger scoops earth at one stream bank; child watches well outside work zone.

pages.title: Deliver the stones
pages.caption: Tip, tumble, stop!
pages.speech: The blue truck brought stones. Its bed lifted slowly. The stones tumbled into a tidy pile. That is enough, said Milo.
pages.art: Blue dump truck tips gravel into a tidy pile beside stream, same child at safe distance.

pages.title: Lift the beams
pages.caption: Up slowly. Down gently.
pages.speech: The crane lifted a strong beam. Everyone stood clear. Up slowly, across carefully, and down gently. The beam joined the two banks.
pages.art: Small yellow crane carefully places wooden beam across stream; child behind low safety fence.

pages.title: Build the path
pages.caption: A smooth path and sturdy rails.
pages.speech: The builders added boards and sturdy rails. They checked for wobbles and sharp edges. A smooth path helps wheels and little feet.
pages.art: Nearly complete wooden bridge, workers attach rails, smooth boards, no dangerous child work.

pages.title: Time to check
pages.caption: The grown-up checks it first.
pages.speech: A grown-up builder checked the finished bridge. Strong, steady, and ready! Milo waited for the all-clear, then walked across with his friend.
pages.art: Adult builder inspects completed bridge while two children wait, friendly trucks behind.

pages.title: Across together
pages.caption: A bridge for little feet and wheels.
pages.speech: Now friends could visit in muddy weather. A little wagon rolled across too. Milo waved to the builders. We made a way for everyone!
pages.art: Two friends and little wagon cross finished bridge with rails; orange digger blue truck yellow crane celebrate quietly.

notes: Original story and illustrations; all family profiles can read it.
